verdict.rationale: Calendly documents an official MCP server (calendly-docs-2, calendly-docs-5, calendly-docs-34, calendly-probe-3) that supports natural-language commands translated into API calls, uses OAuth Dynamic Client Registration for easy setup, and exposes supported tools like event_types-create_event_type. This is first-party documentation of a genuine MCP server, not just API/webhook integration. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server actually working in practice, and more detail on the full breadth of supported tools.
